item.title: Chicago PD - Missing - Review : A Case Close To Home
item.description: I really loved this episode. The character focus episodes this season have been great and so informative of who these characters are deep down, it’s so rare that we get to see character focused episodes for multiple different characters in the span of a season and also still get to see an ensemble.
